tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read one public web page as clean, LLM-ready markdown (title, main text, headings, lists, links, tables) with the page's metadata (description, canonical URL, authors, published date, language), word count and a content hash. Paid per delivered page over x402; a blocked, missing, failing or refused

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "read_page" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
